etc/hooks/cbox_budget.py.purpose: copied into generated/hooks, staged into container claude hooks; reads ~/.claude/cbox-usage/{claude,codex}.json and reports per-window usage metrics (used_percentage, resets_at, elapsed_fraction, pace, age, stale, per-window captured_at falling back to the top-level stamp) via `metrics` CLI subcommand; hosts the shared claude.json merge (combine_window, update_claude_snapshot under claude.json.lock) used by the statusline and the poller; local_tier_present() reports whether a hermes-local MCP server is configured in $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/.claude.json (or ~/.claude.json), shared by the label guard, the statusline and the session-start loader

etc/hooks/claude_usage_refresh.py.purpose: one-shot background poller spawned by usage_statusline.py when ~/.claude/cbox-usage/claude.json is older than CBOX_CLAUDE_USAGE_REFRESH_SEC (default 300, minimum 60; opt-out CBOX_CLAUDE_USAGE_REFRESH=off); GETs the oauth usage endpoint with the access token from $CLAUDE_SECURESTORAGE_CONFIG_DIR/.credentials.json (fallback ~/.claude/.credentials.json) without ever refreshing or writing credentials, skips when the token expires within 60s, single-flights via claude_refresh.lock under a ~10s wall cap, refuses redirects (bearer sent as an unredirected header), honors 429 Retry-After (default 15 min) and stops on 401/403 until expiresAt changes via claude_refresh_attempt.json, and writes claude.json (per-window captured_at, monotonic within a window, serialized by claude.json.lock) with source claude-api

etc/hooks/codex_usage_refresh.py.purpose: one-shot background refresher spawned by usage_statusline.py when ~/.claude/cbox-usage/codex.json is missing or older than 60 minutes; skips silently when codex is not installed or has no auth.json, single-flights via a lock file (codex_refresh.lock, stale after 30s), spawns `codex app-server` under a ~20s wall-clock cap, does the initialize/account/rateLimits/read handshake, and writes codex.json through codex_mcp_shim.py's write_codex_usage_snapshot, loading the shim from beside itself (flat generated/hooks deploy) before ../mcp (repo layout)

etc/hooks/usage_statusline.py.purpose: copied into generated/hooks, staged into container claude hooks; wired as statusLine command, renders `[profile] claude: r5h%/r7d% | codex: r5h%/r7d% | hermes: state | pace: b` (all remaining-quota percentages, each segment omitted when its data is missing, narrow terminals drop pace then hermes then the 7d numbers using a columns/terminal_width stdin field or $COLUMNS); reads CC's rate_limits stdin JSON and atomically writes ~/.claude/cbox-usage/claude.json only when this session's stdin window values changed (per-session state statusline-session.<hash>.json, bounded and pruned; a null window never overwrites a known one), then shows the newest data per window between that session and claude.json before rolling expired windows to 100%; fire-and-forget spawns claude_usage_refresh.py when claude.json is older than CBOX_CLAUDE_USAGE_REFRESH_SEC (default 300, opt-out CBOX_CLAUDE_USAGE_REFRESH=off, attempt stamp claude_refresh_attempt.json); codex segment reads ~/.claude/cbox-usage/codex.json (stale marker past 60min) and fire-and-forget spawns codex_usage_refresh.py (single-flight, cooldown via codex_refresh_attempt.json, opt-out CBOX_CODEX_USAGE_REFRESH=off) when that snapshot is missing or stale; hermes segment is omitted when no hermes-local MCP server is configured, shows `down` when the fresh hermes.json snapshot says unreachable and no slot is busy, and otherwise is a non-blocking flock probe of CBOX_HERMES_DELEGATE_LOCK_DIR slot files plus a bounded tail scan of CBOX_HERMES_DELEGATE_RUNS_DIR run records (start time from the run id's own timestamp prefix, duration from summary.json started/ended) for a median-based ~Nmin estimate, independent of the hermes.json reachability cache cbox_budget.hermes_state()/agent_label_guard.py consume; pace segment is cbox_budget.budget_for_family("claude")'s b value, rendering only, math untouched

layers.container: runs inside the cbox docker image; Linux forever, never ported, excluded from the portability gates
layers.fixture-snapshot: a frozen historical snapshot read as fixture data by a parity test, never executed as a live script; excluded from every gate
layers.host: runs on the developer/operator machine; in scope for the bash-3.2/GNU-bashism portability gates
layers.template-generating-container-content: a script that runs on the host but whose job is to author or stage content that ends up inside the container (compose/dockerfile generation, MCP json rendering, hook staging); the script itself is host-layer and in scope for the gates, the content it emits is container-layer and out of scope
layers.test: lib/test_* host-side test harness; not part of the shipped host/container boundary but tracked so the inventory covers every script in the tree; in scope for the bash-3.2 parse gate (tests must also run on a 3.2 floor host) but not for the GNU/bashism denylist ratchet, which targets production host code only
